images.prompt:
Create a professional eight-frame WALK animation sprite sheet for the brown-haired male adventurer LEON in the reference. Use the reference ONLY for character design, NOT for its poses. Transparent RGBA, 1536x1024. 4 columns, 2 rows. Consistent pixel-art-like warm clean outlines, no grain. Entire character in each cell, identical head/torso/costume dimensions, feet contact at same cell-relative baseline. No background, ground, shadow, text, cell lines. Hands empty, no props. 3/4 RIGHT view throughout, no camera rotation. Exactly eight genuinely successive poses of a SMALL relaxed walking stride, not running.
Animation director's overriding correction: DO NOT draw the rightmost boot connected to the same hip in both contact poses. The nearer leg starts from the hip on the LEFT side of the body in the image; it must SWING ACROSS UNDER THE BODY toward SCREEN RIGHT in frame FIVE. The far leg must then extend back toward SCREEN LEFT, mostly hidden behind the nearer leg. This alternation is essential.
1: FAR leg forward right, NEAR leg back left; near arm forward.
2: FAR leg takes weight, near knee bends behind, near heel rises.
3: FAR leg vertical supporting body; NEAR leg lifts and passes in front of far shin, knee points RIGHT, toe off ground.
4: NEAR foot extends right preparing landing; far heel pushes off behind left.
5: NEAR leg fully forward right, FAR leg fully back left; near arm BACK. Opposite leg and arm from frame1.
6: NEAR leg takes weight, FAR knee bends behind.
7: NEAR leg vertical supporting; FAR leg lifted passing behind near shin, knee points right.
8: FAR foot extends forward right; near heel pushes off behind left, return to1.
Frames1 and5 have opposite leg ownership. Frames3 and7 are nearly closed silhouettes with ONE supporting foot, NOT wide strides. Keep torso leaning gently right 3 degrees, shoulder counter-rotation, tiny head bob, cape follows. Feet never point left. Preserve complete boot shapes, not melting. No drastic head-size changes. Room-friendly gentle walking.

Production eight-frame walking sprite sheet for the SAME character as the reference, which is for identity/costume/style only. No text, lines, panels, effects, shadows, floor or painted background.
Match reference's warm pixel-art-like clean dark brown contour and broad readable shaded color clusters. Remove noisy stippling; crisp face and eyes.
